## Type

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] chore — non-functional change
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — restructure without behavior change
- [ ] test — test-only change

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (unit + relevant integration suites)
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] User-visible changes documented in `README.md` and/or `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No personal data, real API keys, or production URLs in the diff
- [ ] If touching auth / action engine / MCP: smoke-tested locally (`npm run smoke:mcp` / `smoke:rest`)
